annotations.title: ERC-20 token quick scan (cheaper, no simulation)

description: Quick ERC-20 token pre-check from on-chain data (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC): name/symbol/decimals/supply, owner and renounced status, proxy detection and a bytecode scan for mint, blacklist, adjustable fee, max-tx, trading switch and pause functions, with flags and a risk level. No honeypot simulation (use token_safety_check for that). $0.005 USDC on Base via x402. Price: $0.005 per token. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.
